20374-capitals-a-primer-of-information-a.creator: Unknown
20374-capitals-a-primer-of-information-a.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. line in the stanza just preceding. Use a capital letter to begin every quotation consisting of a complete sentence. _Ben Franklin says, "Honesty is the best policy."_  _The campaign was "a punitive expedition for the suppression of  brigandage."_   Capitalize:  1. Names of the Deity, of the members of the Trinity, of the Virgin Mary, and of the Devil, when a personal devil is referred to. When the word devil is used as a general term or as an expletive the capital is not used.

arxiv-2112-05039.title: Bell-inequality in path-entangled single photon and purity of single photon state
arxiv-2112-05039.creator: K. Muhammed Shafi, R. S. Gayatri, A. Padhye, C. M. Chandrashekar
arxiv-2112-05039.description: Abstract Different degrees of freedom of single photons have been entangled and are used as a resource for various quantum technology applications. We present a simple scheme to perform Bell’s test and show the violation of CHSH inequality in a path-entangled single photon state using interferometric and its equivalent non-interferometric approach in beam splitter setting.

arxiv-2204-13698.title: How Much is Performance Worth to Users? A Quantitative Approach
arxiv-2204-13698.creator: Adam Hastings Lydia B. Chilton Simha Sethumadhavan
arxiv-2204-13698.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Adam Hastings Lydia B. Chilton Simha Sethumadhavan. Architects and systems designers artfully balance multiple competing design constraints during the design process but are unable to translate between system metrics and end user experience. This work presents three methodologies to fill in this gap.

arxiv-2205-04105.title: Re-thinking Knowledge Graph Completion Evaluation from an Information Retrieval Perspective Conference: Proceedings of the 45th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 11–15, 2022; Madrid, Spain Proceedings of the 45th International ACM SIGIR Con
arxiv-2205-04105.creator: Ying Zhou, Xuanang Chen, Ben He, Zheng Ye, Le Sun
arxiv-2205-04105.description: Abstract . Knowledge graph completion (KGC) aims to infer missing knowledge triples based on known facts in a knowledge graph. Current KGC research mostly follows an entity ranking protocol, wherein the effectiveness is measured by the predicted rank of a masked entity in a test triple.

arxiv-2303-17740.title: A CI-based Auditing Framework for Data Collection Practices
arxiv-2303-17740.creator: Athina Markopoulou, Rahmadi Trimananda, Hao Cui
arxiv-2303-17740.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Athina Markopoulou, Rahmadi Trimananda, Hao Cui. Apps and devices (mobile devices, web browsers, IoT, VR, voice assistants, etc. ) routinely collect user data, and send them to first- and third-party servers through the network. Recently, there is a lot of interest in (1) auditing the actual data collection practices of those systems; and also in (2) checking the consistency of those practices against the statements made in the corresponding privacy policies.

arxiv-2308-15950.title: AVIS Engine: High Performance Networking Layer for Simulation Applications
arxiv-2308-15950.creator: Amir Mohammad Zarif Shahsavan Nejad, Amir Mahdi Zarif Shahsavan Nejad, Amirali Setayeshi, Soroush Sadeghnejad
arxiv-2308-15950.description: Abstract Autonomous vehicles are one of the most popular and also fast-growing technologies in the world. As we go further, there are still a lot of challenges that are unsolved and may cause problems in the future when it comes to testing in real world.

arxiv-2311-01243.title: Revisiting MAB based approaches to recursive delegation
arxiv-2311-01243.creator: Nir Oren
arxiv-2311-01243.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nir Oren. In this paper we examine the effectiveness of several multi-arm bandit algorithms when used as a trust system to select agents to delegate tasks to. In contrast to existing work, we allow for recursive delegation to occur. That is, a task delegated to one agent can be delegated onwards by that agent, with further delegation possible until some agent finally executes the task.

arxiv-2401-06497.title: Spatially resolved mapping of coherent twin relationships in DFXM measurements
arxiv-2401-06497.creator: Mads Carlsen, Marion Höfling, Carsten Detlefs, Hugh Simons
arxiv-2401-06497.description: Abstract 1 Introduction In many oxides of fundamental and techonological interest, a slightly broken symmetry from a high-temperature to a low-temperature phase results in pseudomerohedral twinning [ 9 , 5 ] of crystals in the low temperature phase. The resulting twin-domains tend to organize in hierarchical structures of domains and super-domains.

arxiv-2402-07758.title: Semistability conditions defined by ample classes
arxiv-2402-07758.creator: Damien Mégy, Mihai Pavel, Matei Toma
arxiv-2402-07758.description: Abstract . We study a class of semistability conditions defined by a system of ample classes for coherent sheaves over a smooth projective variety. Under some necessary boundedness assumptions, we show the existence of a well-behaved chamber structure for the variation of moduli spaces of sheaves with respect to the change of semistability. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 32G13, 14D20 1.

arxiv-2504-18894.title: Maximal curves over finite fields and a modular isogeny
arxiv-2504-18894.creator: Valerio Dose, Guido Lido, Pietro Mercuri, Claudio Stirpe
arxiv-2504-18894.description: Abstract . We prove the existence of curves of genus 7 7 and 12 12 over the field with 11 5 11^{5} elements, reaching the Hasse-Weil-Serre upper bound. These curves are quotients of modular curves and we give explicit equations. We compute the number of points of many quotient modular curves in the same family without providing equations.

arxiv-2602-14873.title: Reduction of bar fraction in paired galaxies in the SDSS Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2602-14873.creator: Linlin Li (李林林), Shuai Feng (冯帅), Shiyin Shen (沈世银), Qi’an Deng (邓淇安), Ying Zu (祖颖), Wenyuan Cui (崔文元)
arxiv-2602-14873.description: Abstract We investigate the bar fraction in galaxy pairs from the SDSS to assess how galaxy interactions affect bar structures. Compared to isolated galaxies, close pairs exhibit a significantly reduced bar fraction at projected separations within 25 ​ h − 1 ​ kpc 25\ h^{-1}\ \text{kpc} .

arxiv-2602-18082.title: AndroWasm: an Empirical Study on Android Malware Obfuscation through WebAssembly
arxiv-2602-18082.creator: Diego Soi, Silvia Lucia Sanna, Lorenzo Pisu, Leonardo Regano, Giorgio Giacinto
arxiv-2602-18082.description: Abstract In recent years, stealthy Android malware has increasingly adopted sophisticated techniques to bypass automatic detection mechanisms and harden manual analysis. Adversaries typically rely on obfuscation, anti-repacking, steganography, poisoning, and evasion techniques to AI-based tools, and in-memory execution to conceal malicious functionality.

pmc-11380814.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: The objective was to study the effectiveness and diagnostic outcome of frame-based stereotactic brain biopsy (STB) done for contrast non-enhancing lesions using indirect evidence of target selection observed in a plain computed tomography (CT) scan of the head.Methods: Data of patients with contrast non-enhancing brain lesions who underwent STB are collected retrospectively from NIMHANS Bangalore, hospital neurosurgery database from January 2021 to March 2023.

pmc-11511102.title: Off-Label Pediatric Medication Prescribing and Dispensing: Awareness and Attitudes among Community Pharmacists: A Questionnaire-Based Study
pmc-11511102.creator: Carmen-Maria Jîtcă, George Jîtcă, Imre Silvia, Hans De Loof
pmc-11511102.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Off-label practice in pediatrics requires relentless engagement from all the health professionals involved. Community pharmacists are the last ones in the prescribing–dispensing chain; therefore, they have the key responsibility of verifying the correctness of a treatment. A cross-sectional study was conducted for assessing the awareness and views of Romanian community pharmacists, regarding off-label drugs in the pediatric population, through a 28-item questionnaire comprising five sections of different topics (general knowledge, frequency of prescribing and dispensing off-label medication, views, and attitudes).

pmc-11606811.title: Hydroxysafflor yellow A, a natural food pigment, ameliorates atherosclerosis in ApoE −/− mice by inhibiting the SphK1/S1P/S1PR3 pathway
pmc-11606811.creator: Yuqing Liu, Jingyu Piao, Jiqian He, Zhuoxuan Su, Zhizhong Luo, Duosheng Luo
pmc-11606811.description: Atherosclerosis (AS) is the pathologic basis of many cardiovascular diseases (CVDs). Hydroxysafflor yellow A (HSYA) is a valuable natural food pigment that has been reported to have significant health‐promoting abilities. However, the anti‐AS efficacy and mechanisms of HSYA have not yet been characterized.

pmc-11691334.title: INCLUSIVE CROSS-CULTURAL LEARNING: END-OF-LIFE CRITICAL CARE ACROSS KOREAN AND AMERICAN LITERATURE
pmc-11691334.creator: Soo Hyun Kim, Rebecca Wright
pmc-11691334.description: BackgroundKorean Americans are the fastest growing racial-ethnic population in the US, however, demographic reporting often groups by race, prohibiting exploration of ethnic and cultural needs. This represents a challenge for clinicians tailoring end-of-life care in critical care environments. ObjectivesReport the state of the science from a scoping review of Korean and American end-of-life critical care literature.

pmc-12468380.title: Using Functional Education Appliance on One Patient with Class III Malocclusion in Mixed Dentition: A Case Report
pmc-12468380.creator: Chun-Yuan Chiu, Shang-Wen Chiu, Chung-Hsing Li, Stefania Dinu
pmc-12468380.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Prefabricated myofunctional appliances are effective options for managing skeletal Class III malocclusion in pediatric patients with vertical mandibular growth patterns.Treatment with prefabricated myofunctional appliances has a three-dimensional effect: sagittal, transverse, and vertical. What is the implication of the main finding?

pmc-12848005.title: Combined ketone body and glutamine supplementation restores aerobic energy production in AGC1-deficient neuronal progenitors
pmc-12848005.creator: Simona Nicole Barile, Maria Chiara Magnifico, Eleonora Poeta, Felix Distelmaier, Luigi Viggiano, Nicola Balboni, Michele Protti, Sabrina Petralla, Antonella Pignataro, Giacomo Volpe, Monica De Luise, Massimo Bonora, Marica Antonicelli, Giorgia Babini, Francesca Massenzio, Vito Porcelli, Eleonora Lam
pmc-12848005.description: AGC1 deficiency is a rare, early-onset encephalopathy caused by mutations in the SLC25A12 gene, encoding the mitochondrial aspartate/glutamate carrier isoform 1 (AGC1). Patients exhibit epileptic encephalopathy, cerebral hypomyelination, severe hypotonia, and global developmental delay. A hallmark biochemical feature of AGC1 deficiency is reduced brain N-acetylaspartate (NAA), a key metabolite involved in myelin lipid synthesis.

pmc-12876130.title: Adaptive gait transition in trekking pole-assisted hiking due to fatigue and staircase height elevation
pmc-12876130.creator: Yusuke Koshimizu, Akira Fukuhara, Yuji Yamamoto, Akifumi Kijima
pmc-12876130.description: Humans adapt their gait patterns in response to both internal (e.g., fatigue) and external (e.g., terrain) constraints. Although bipedal locomotion is generally efficient, its stability is reduced on steep or uneven surfaces. Under such conditions, adult hikers often use trekking poles to enhance stability and reduce physical load.

pmc-13021690.title: Comprehensive Immune-Phenotyping of Peripheral Lymphocytes in Coronary Artery Disease Reveals Potential Roles of Effector Memory and PD-1⁺ CD4⁺ T Cells
pmc-13021690.creator: Xin Huang, Jiaxi Cheng, Leidan Zhang, Lei Jia, Chao Wu, Liyuan Zheng, Fada Wang, Kefei Dou, Taisheng Li
pmc-13021690.description: Chronic inflammation plays a key role in the pathogenesis of coronary artery disease (CAD), yet the peripheral immune profile in CAD remains insufficiently characterized. This study aimed to assess circulating lymphocyte subsets in CAD patients and their potential clinical relevance. Peripheral blood from 48 patients with angiographically confirmed CAD and 14 age- and sex-matched controls was analyzed using flow cytometry.

pmc-13082688.title: The slow transformation of the collectivist education of child refugees from Greece in socialist Czechoslovakia
pmc-13082688.creator: Kateřina Králová, Nikola Tohma, Jessie Barton Hronešová
pmc-13082688.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Using a Slow Memory framework, which foregrounds sustained, reflective engagement with the past, this article examines the evolving institutional care provided to child refugees from the Greek Civil War (1946–1949) in socialist Czechoslovakia. Rather than interpreting their experiences primarily through trauma or rupture, the analysis focuses on the long-term everyday realities of life in childcare institutions, recalling both supportive and constraining aspects as remembered by the children and shaped by state authorities.

pmc-13092814.title: The Effect of Flexor Hallucis Longus Morphology on Os Trigonum Syndrome
pmc-13092814.creator: Nathan Chaclas, Morgan E. Swanson, Vandan Patel, Jie C. Nguyen, Kathleen J. Maguire
pmc-13092814.description: Background:Os trigonum (OT) is an accessory bone at the posterior ankle that can lead to posterior ankle impingement. The flexor hallucis longus (FHL) muscle is a potential contributor to this pathology as it passes through the fibro-osseous tunnel behind the medial malleolus adjacent to the talus.

pmc-13212562.title: Green synthesis of ZnO nanoparticles from melon peel and mint stem: antibacterial, antioxidant, and dye degradation potential
pmc-13212562.creator: Mariyam Nasir, Azka Naeem, Linta Zeeshan Khan, Nida Zaib, Hanzala Khan, Zainab Najam, Anum Gul
pmc-13212562.description: Synthesis of nanoparticles employing plant extracts represents a green and sustainable strategy that reduces the use of toxic chemicals and offers a cost-effective alternative to conventional synthesis methods. In this context, the present study focused on the green synthesis of zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO-NPs) utilizing melon (Cucumis melo) peel and mint (Mentha piperita L.

pmc-13213550.title: Generic microfluidic platform for digital droplet-based bioassays
pmc-13213550.creator: Julia Sophie Böke, Cornelia Reuter, Mark Kielpinski, Anett Reichert, Iris Prinz, Daniel Horner, Adrian Prinz, Fritz Bichler, Rudolf Aichinger, Anton Rettenbacher, Georg Bauer, Maria Bauer, Susanne Pahlow, Karina Weber, Thomas Henkel
pmc-13213550.description: Digital droplet-based bioassays (ddAssays) have been applied in numerous fields, though many existing microfluidic platforms are tailored to specific assay classes and require complex workflows involving multiple processing steps. Here, we present a fully integrated microfluidic platform for generic digital bioassays that combines droplet generation and storage for on-chip incubation and optical readout on a single disposable device.

pmc-13374745.title: Healthcare resource utilization and economic burden of metastatic pancreatic cancer: a US commercial and Medicare claims analysis
pmc-13374745.creator: Rupali Fuldeore, Adaeze Q. Amaefule, Gergana Georgieva, Tomomi Kimura, Baoguo Jiang, Kenneth H. Yu
pmc-13374745.description: AimTo assess healthcare resource utilization (HRU) and costs among patients with metastatic pancreatic cancer (mPC).Patients and methodsAdult US patients with an mPC diagnosis based on index date 1 January 2020–31 December 2022 were identified in the Merative MarketScan database. All-cause healthcare visits and costs (USD) were estimated per-person-per-month (PPPM) for 1 year post-index period.

pmc-13424147.title: Equity, evidence and Indigenous knowledges in PROMs in Australian injury research: a systematic review
pmc-13424147.creator: Georga Sallows, Patrick Sharpe, Pip Henderson, Lavender Otieno, Daniel Y. Ellis, Nicole Kelly, Mahni Foster, Belinda Gabbe, Mark Fitzgerald, Julieann Coombes, Luke Wolfenden, Brett Shannon, Gerard O’Reilly, Murthy Mittinty, Kate Hunter, Shanti Omodei-James, Hossein Haji Ali Afzali, Maree Toombs, Cou
pmc-13424147.description: PurposePatient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) are widely used in trauma and injury research to assess health-related quality of life (HRQoL), mental health and functional recovery. However, PROMs are rarely adapted to reflect the lived experiences, cultural values and determinants of health for priority populations, particularly Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, who experience a disproportionate burden of injury in Australia.

pmc-13429621.title: BCL9 inhibition promotes fibroblast lipogenesis by regulating macrophage–fibroblast interactions to attenuate pulmonary fibrosis
pmc-13429621.creator: Wenjie Wang, Yuan Zhang, Fenglian He, Li Sun, Huiyu Li, Rongchen Liu, Guanglin Zhong, Ling Zhang, Anqi Li, Mei Feng, Yuxuan Dong, Xiaoxuan Lu, Xiaojin Wang, Yuan Si, Yejun Wu, Mengmeng Zhao, Dafu Zhu, Zhuyi Xi, Jian Chen, Jing Chen, Ming-Wei Wang, Di Zhu, Likun Gong, Bingshun Wang
pmc-13429621.description: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a progressive and fatal interstitial lung disease with an urgent need for novel therapeutic strategies. M2 macrophage-derived TGF-β1 promotes fibroblast myogenesis, contributing to IPF pathogenesis. Targeting macrophage polarization and fibroblast function thus represents an effective therapeutic approach for treating IPF.
